purpose: Test one target-local waveform-specific recovery operation for the independently anchored cluster 553 detection dropout without changing global Kilosort thresholds or launching a sort.

operation.name: target_local_permissive_peak_proposal_then_template_gate
operation.template_source: curated cluster 553 retained spikes in template_and_calibration only; legacy cluster 425 is forbidden from template construction and threshold calibration

proposal.noise_estimator: per-channel median absolute deviation divided by 0.6744897501960817 in the template interval

gate.matched_filter_score_threshold: maximum of the 99.9th percentile of circular-shift background scores and the 10th percentile of retained target-spike scores

required_controls: report reference and failing proposal counts before and after the gate
report overlap with existing target-local full_st and curated cluster 553
report independent-anchor recovery separately for previously matched and unmatched events
report circular-shift background acceptance and refractory effect
preserve every existing spike and label; candidate additions remain unvalidated

decision.advance: Only if every numerical evaluation gate passes. Advancement authorizes a broader held-out diagnostic contract, not production use or a sort.
decision.stop: Reject this operation if calibration cannot simultaneously control shifted background and preserve reference target sensitivity, or if failing unmatched recovery, waveform similarity, or refractory preservation fails.
decision.ambiguous: Stop without tuning thresholds or adding another arm.
